title: Cyber claims from Will's bookmarks, Nov 18 to 19 (one line per claim): European Commission hit by an attack using the ARTEX AI tool, salary and leave systems down over 10 days, per POLITICO via an aggregator (not found by WALTER's search); MUFG '6.5 million customer records' leak (aggregator post; NOT FOUND, image a stock photo; do not relay as fact); DHS says Iran-linked hackers target US energy, water and transport; senators say AI cyber threats outpace defenses (Reuters)
body:
# Cyber claims, Will's X bookmarks (posts read; linked sources not opened)

One table line per claim (CYPHER protocol rule 0): victim, actor, claim date, source handle, figure exactly as claimed.

| Victim | Actor | Claim date | Source handle | Claim as written | WALTER check |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| European Commission | not named; the ARTEX AI vulnerability tool reportedly used | 2026-11-19 09:42Z | @InsiderGeo citing POLITICO | 'major cyberattack', large amounts of personal data possibly compromised; salary, leave and medical reimbursement services down more than 10 days; Corporate Management Board emergency meeting; spokesperson Thomas Regnier confirmed individual systems targeted | WALTER's search found no November 2026 coverage (only the January and March 2026 Commission incidents); POLITICO page not read. ARTEX: FBI warnings in the lane 11/15 to 11/18 |
| MUFG (Japan) | not named | 2026-11-18 11:53Z | @macropaperr | 'confirmed a data leak of 6.5 Million customer records' | **NOT FOUND**: no article, filing or regulator notice in WALTER's search; the post's images are a stock MUFG sign and a stock chart. Claim only; do not relay as fact |
| US energy, water, transportation | Iran-linked hackers | 2026-11-18 16:03Z | @InsiderWire citing DHS | DHS says Iran-linked hackers are targeting them | DHS bulletin not read |
| (policy) | n/a | 2026-11-18 15:17Z | @unusual_whales citing Reuters | US senators say AI-enabled cyber threats are outpacing defenses | Reuters page not read |

**Duplicate, not a new claim:** @Polymarket 11/18 02:16Z 'bank executives and the NSA told Congress that patching AI-discovered flaws contributed to recent outages' is the FT title already on card 20261118-014.

The 11/17 do-not-relay list (card 20261117-029) still binds.
